title: Heroes of Might and Magic V
provenance: Reported by thomaskuncewicz (highball-db#473, 2026-10-13), the GOG edition (H5_Game.exe), Apple M1 Max, macOS 14.5, Highball 0.10.15, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r26, DXVK with async shader compilation, rated 4 of 5 after 3 minutes. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Reported playable on an M1 Max with DXVK, with a one second frame drop at most about once a minute on busy scenes. To get a window instead of fullscreen, start the game once on WineD3D so it writes its profile, then set gfx_fullscreen to 0 in profiles, default_profile, user_a2.cfg and switch back to DXVK.

knownIssues.symptom: Occasional one second frame drop on busy scenes, at most about once a minute
